name: Barbell Pendlay Row
steps: Stand with a barbell over your midfoot, hinge with soft knees until your torso is nearly horizontal, and take a wide overhand grip.
Brace your abdomen and keep your neck in line with your spine before pulling.
Drive your elbows back to lift the bar toward your lower chest without raising your torso.
Lower the bar under control all the way back to a full dead stop on the floor before each repetition.
tips: Keep your torso parallel to the floor rather than lifting your chest up to meet the bar.
Reset your flat back cleanly during the brief pause on the floor between repetitions.
